SHREYA 

ServiceNow Developer

ITSM · CSM · HRSD · Flow Designer · IntegrationHub · 4+ Years

yashreya1211@gmail.com    ·    +91 9063898431

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of hands-on development experience delivering production-grade implementations across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, ITOM, and CMDB modules for telecom, healthcare insurance, and managed services enterprises. Strong full-stack ServiceNow development across JavaScript ES2022+, Glide APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideAjax, GlideForm, GlideSystem), Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Scoped Applications. Hands-on Flow Designer and IntegrationHub developer authoring record-triggered, scheduled, and API-triggered flows with subflow libraries, parallel branches, Decision Tables, custom Actions via Action Designer, and IntegrationHub spokes for REST, SOAP, JDBC, and email steps. Strong Service Portal and Agent Workspace developer building AngularJS widgets, page configuration, themes, branding, and responsive mobile-first design. 

ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of hands-on implementation experience delivering production-grade ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, ITOM, and CMDB modules for telecom (Verizon), healthcare insurance (Elevance Health), and managed services (Aetna / CVS Health) clients in the United States.

Strong full-stack ServiceNow development across JavaScript ES2022+, TypeScript, Glide APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideAjax, GlideForm, GlideSystem, GlideDateTime, GlideElement), Business Rules (before / after / async / display), Client Scripts (onLoad / onChange / onSubmit), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), UI Policies, UI Actions, and Scoped Applications.

Deep Flow Designer and Process Automation Designer (PAD) developer authoring record-triggered, scheduled, API-triggered, and application-triggered flows with subflow libraries, parallel branches, Decision Tables, Wait-for-Condition, error handlers with retry semantics, and custom Actions via Action Designer.

Hands-on IntegrationHub developer building custom spokes for REST, SOAP, JDBC, PowerShell, and email steps - configured Connection & Credential records, designed payload transformations with JSON / XML parsing, and authored Flow Designer connectors consumed across the platform.

Strong ITSM developer with deep configuration of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management (Normal / Standard / Emergency), Request Management, Service Catalog, Service Portal, Knowledge Management with KCS, and Major Incident Management (MIM) Workbench.

Hands-on CSM (Customer Service Management) developer covering Case Management lifecycle, Consumer / Account / Contact hierarchies, SLA and Entitlements Engine, Knowledge Management, Agent Workspace, Customer Service Portal, Communities, Virtual Agent with NLU, Omnichannel intake, and Advanced Work Assignment (AWA).

Strong HRSD (HR Service Delivery) developer configuring Employee Center, HR Case Management, Lifecycle Events (onboarding, transfer, offboarding), HR Service Catalog, Knowledge Management with HR articles, and integration with Workday HCM and Active Directory.

Hands-on Service Portal developer with custom AngularJS widgets, page configuration, themes, branding, JavaScript client scripting, HTML5 / CSS3 styling, jQuery, Bootstrap, and the responsive mobile-first design discipline aligned to WCAG 2.1 accessibility requirements.

CMDB and CSDM practitioner managing CIs across hybrid cloud (AWS, Azure) and on-premises infrastructure with IRE reconciliation, Health Dashboard scorecards, Discovery patterns, Service Mapping, and data certification campaigns.

Strong Service Catalog developer building catalog items with variables, variable sets, multi-row variable sets, catalog client scripts, catalog UI policies, record producers, and fulfillment workflows with approval matrices and SLA configuration.

Hands-on Virtual Agent developer with NLU model training, intent recognition, entity extraction, conversational topic design, Decision Tables for branching logic, Live Agent hand-off patterns, and integration with Microsoft Teams and Slack.

Strong REST and SOAP API integration developer authoring Scripted REST APIs, Scripted SOAP services, REST Message authoring, SOAP Message authoring, OAuth 2.0 configuration, JWT, MID Server connectivity, and named-credential management for enterprise system integrations.

Update Set governance discipline across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, conflict resolution, source control through ServiceNow Studio, ATF (Automated Test Framework) regression suites, and Instance Scan.

Strong Performance Analytics developer configuring KPIs, Indicators, Breakdowns, Scorecards, Dashboards, scheduled PDF / Excel distribution, and Reports for executive visibility into ITSM, CSM, and HRSD operations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

ServiceNow Modules:  ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Service Catalog), CSM, HRSD (Employee Center, Lifecycle Events), ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management), CMDB / CSDM, Knowledge Management, Agent Workspace, Service Portal, App Engine

Core Development:  JavaScript ES2022+, TypeScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideAjax, GlideForm, GlideSystem, GlideDateTime, GlideElement, GlideHTTPRequest, Business Rules (before / after / async / display), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), Scheduled Jobs, Scripted REST APIs, ACL Scripts

Flow Designer & IntegrationHub:  Flow Designer (Record-Triggered, Scheduled, API-Triggered, Application Triggers), Subflows, Parallel Branches, Decision Tables, Wait for Condition, Error Handlers, IntegrationHub Spokes, Custom Actions with Action Designer, Process Automation Designer (PAD)

Service Portal & UI:  Service Portal (Custom AngularJS Widgets, Page Configuration, Themes, Branding), Agent Workspace, Customer Service Portal, Employee Center, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, Mobile-First Design, WCAG 2.1 Accessibility

Integrations & APIs:  REST / SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, JWT, API Keys, Named Credentials, MID Server (Configuration, Clustering), Webhooks, Transform Maps, Import Sets, Active Directory, LDAP, Workday HCM, SAP, Splunk, Slack, Microsoft Teams

Service Catalog:  Catalog Items, Variables and Variable Sets, Multi-Row Variable Sets, Catalog Client Scripts, Catalog UI Policies, Record Producers, Order Guides, Fulfillment Workflows, Approval Matrices, Catalog Builder

Virtual Agent & NLU:  Virtual Agent Topic Design, NLU Model Training, Intent Recognition, Entity Extraction, Decision Tables, Live Agent Hand-Off, Conversational Branching, Microsoft Teams Integration, Slack Integration

Reporting & Analytics:  Performance Analytics (KPIs, Indicators, Breakdowns, Scorecards, Dashboards), Reports, Scheduled PDF / Excel Distribution, Database Views, Metric Definitions, Trend Analysis

Platform Governance:  ACLs (Table / Field / Record / Script-Based), Role Hierarchies, RBAC, Data Policies, Domain Separation, ATF (Automated Test Framework), Instance Scan, Update Set Governance (DEV / QA / UAT / PROD), Studio Source Control

Methodologies:  Agile / Scrum, Kanban, ITIL v4, DevOps, CI / CD, SDLC, UAT, Release Management, CAB, Now Create methodology

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

ServiceNow Developer  |  ITSM, ITOM & CMDB	March 2024 – Present

Synergy Infomatics services Pvt ltd. (WIPRO ) (Client: Verizon Communications)    ·    Bengaluru, India  ·  Telecommunications

Working as ServiceNow Developer on Verizon's enterprise telecommunications platform across the Washington DC, Xanadu, and Yokohama releases - delivering production-grade implementations across ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB / CSDM 4.0+ modules for Verizon's nationwide telecom operations.

Developed Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management workflows for Verizon IT operations - configured custom incident categories, assignment rules based on CMDB CI relationships, SLA definitions, escalation matrices, and integration with legacy ticketing systems.

Built Major Incident Management (MIM) Workbench for high-priority network outages - configured automated stakeholder notification trees, bridge call initiation workflows, structured status communication templates, and customer notification automation for affected enterprise B2B accounts.

Developed reusable server-side components using JavaScript and GlideRecord - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), GlideAjax callbacks for dynamic form behavior, scheduled jobs, and Scripted REST APIs.

Built Flow Designer orchestrations for incident routing based on CI relationships, change automation for network changes, problem investigation workflows, and cross-team coordination using record-triggered flows with subflow libraries, parallel branches, and Decision Tables.

Designed IntegrationHub spokes connecting ServiceNow with Verizon's BSS / OSS ecosystem, billing systems, network management platforms (IBM Netcool, Splunk, Dynatrace), Active Directory, and customer service tools using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication and MID Server connectivity.

Built CMDB / CSDM 4.0+ governance covering CI lifecycle management, IRE reconciliation rules, Health Dashboard scorecards, Service Graph Connectors for hybrid cloud assets, and the data certification campaign discipline enforced quarterly.

Configured Discovery patterns for Verizon's nationwide network infrastructure - MID Server cluster configuration, IP-based and credential-based discovery schedules, horizontal discovery for Windows / Linux servers, and vertical discovery for telecom application services.

Built Service Mapping for customer-facing telecom service applications including wireless billing, customer portal, network operations dashboard, and back-office systems with automated CI relationship discovery and dependency tracking.

Configured Event Management alert correlation rules using regex-based event field mapping and threshold-based alert grouping, consolidating related network alarms, reducing individual alert tickets reaching the NOC, and enabling proactive customer case creation.

Built Service Portal custom widgets using AngularJS for IT support intake, request submission, and knowledge article browsing - configured page layouts, custom themes aligned to Verizon branding, and responsive design with mobile-first patterns.

Configured Service Catalog items for IT services - variables, variable sets, multi-row variable sets for bulk request scenarios, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies for conditional field visibility, and fulfillment workflows.

Established ATF (Automated Test Framework) regression suites with 300+ test cases covering ITSM workflows, ITOM Discovery patterns, CMDB reconciliation logic, and custom integration workflows - enabled a monthly release cycle with zero regression incidents on production.

Managed Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, conflict resolution, and the deployment-promotion gates aligned to Verizon's change-control discipline.

Coordinated with Verizon network operations, IT, and engineering teams - participated in daily Agile / Scrum ceremonies with story sizing, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint demos, and retrospective documentation discipline.

ServiceNow Developer  |  CSM, HRSD & Service Portal	January 2023 – February 2024

WIPRO  (Client: Elevance Health)    ·    Bengaluru, India  ·  Healthcare Insurance

Worked as ServiceNow Developer on Elevance Health's enterprise platform across the Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC releases - delivered CSM, HRSD, and Service Portal implementations for Elevance Health's healthcare insurance operations serving members and providers.

Built CSM Case Management for Elevance Health member services covering case lifecycle, parent / child case relationships, case types (claims inquiry, benefits questions, provider issues, billing disputes), SLA and Entitlements engine, omnichannel intake, and Agent Workspace configuration for contact center productivity.

Configured HRSD Employee Center for Elevance HR operations - HR Case Management with case types (benefits, payroll, leave, onboarding), Lifecycle Events (onboarding, transfer, offboarding) with multi-step task orchestration, HR Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management with HR articles.

Developed reusable server-side components using JavaScript and GlideRecord - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), GlideAjax callbacks for dynamic form behavior, scheduled jobs, and Scripted REST APIs for external system integrations.

Built Flow Designer orchestrations for member case lifecycle, HR onboarding workflows, claims case routing, and approval workflows covering record-triggered flows, subflow libraries, parallel branches, Decision Tables for category-based routing, and Wait-for-Condition for SLA-based escalations.

Designed IntegrationHub spokes connecting ServiceNow with Elevance's Workday HCM, Active Directory, monitoring tools, and legacy claims processing systems using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication and MID Server connectivity.

Built Service Portal custom widgets using AngularJS for member self-service, employee request submission, and IT support intake - configured page layouts, themes aligned to Elevance branding, and responsive design with WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance.

Configured Service Catalog items for IT and HR services - variables, variable sets, multi-row variable sets for bulk request scenarios, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies for conditional field visibility, and fulfillment workflows with multi-tier approval matrices.

Developed Virtual Agent topics for member self-service (claims status, benefits lookup, ID card request), IT support (password reset, software request, access request), and HR (benefits inquiry, leave balance, onboarding status) - trained NLU models with healthcare-specific intent recognition.

Built Omnichannel intake configuration for inbound case creation across email (Inbound Email Actions with parsing scripts), web (Customer Service Portal record producers), chat (Virtual Agent with healthcare NLU topics), and Live Agent hand-off patterns.

Configured Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) for skill-based case routing using agent capacity, language skills, healthcare specialization (claims vs benefits vs provider), and geography-based routing ensuring complex member issues reach correctly skilled agents.

Established Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, conflict resolution, and the deployment-promotion gates aligned to Elevance's HIPAA-compliant change-control discipline.

ServiceNow Developer  |  ITSM & Service Catalog	October 2021 – December 2022

ACCENTURE  (Client: Aetna / CVS Health)    ·    Hyderabad, India  ·  Healthcare Insurance

Worked as ServiceNow Developer on Aetna / CVS Health's enterprise platform across the Rome, San Diego, and Tokyo releases - delivered ITSM, Service Catalog, and Service Portal implementations for Aetna's healthcare insurance operations.

Developed Incident Management workflows for Aetna IT operations - configured custom incident categories, assignment rules based on category and CMDB CI relationships, SLA definitions, escalation matrices, and integration with monitoring tools for automated incident creation.

Built Change Management workflows covering Normal / Standard / Emergency change types with CAB approval workflows, risk and impact assessment forms, change schedule conflict detection, and integration with Aetna's healthcare change-control discipline.

Developed Service Catalog for Aetna IT services covering hardware requests, software installation, access provisioning, and IT service requests - configured variables, variable sets, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies, and fulfillment workflows.

Built Service Portal custom AngularJS widgets for self-service IT support, request submission, and knowledge article browsing - configured page layouts, custom themes aligned to Aetna branding, and responsive design with mobile-first patterns.

Developed JavaScript and Glide API server-side components - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype), Client Scripts (onLoad / onChange / onSubmit), UI Policies, and ACLs for the regulated healthcare workflow requirements.

Built Flow Designer orchestrations (mature framework in this era) for incident routing, change automation, request fulfillment, and approval workflows replacing legacy Workflow Editor scripts.

Designed IntegrationHub integrations connecting ServiceNow with Aetna's enterprise monitoring tools, Active Directory, healthcare claims systems, and legacy mainframes using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication.

Built CMDB governance covering CI lifecycle management, Discovery patterns for Aetna's hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure, IRE reconciliation, and Service Mapping for healthcare application services with dependency tracking.

Configured Knowledge Management with KCS methodology - article lifecycle management, knowledge base structuring, article templates, search optimization, and integration with Virtual Agent for knowledge-driven self-service.

Established Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, and the deployment-promotion process aligned to Aetna's HIPAA-compliant change-control discipline.

Built Performance Analytics dashboards for IT operations covering incident MTTR, change success rate, SLA compliance, request fulfillment metrics, and service catalog adoption with automated distribution to Aetna IT leadership.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ServiceNow Developer  |  ITSM, ITOM & CMDB	March 2024 – Present
Synergy Infomatics services Pvt ltd. (WIPRO ) (Client: Verizon Communications)    ·    Bengaluru, India  ·  Telecommunications
Working as ServiceNow Developer on Verizon's enterprise telecommunications platform across the Washington DC, Xanadu, and Yokohama releases - delivering production-grade implementations across ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB / CSDM 4.0+ modules for Verizon's nationwide telecom operations.
Developed Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Management workflows for Verizon IT operations - configured custom incident categories, assignment rules based on CMDB CI relationships, SLA definitions, escalation matrices, and integration with legacy ticketing systems.
Built Major Incident Management (MIM) Workbench for high-priority network outages - configured automated stakeholder notification trees, bridge call initiation workflows, structured status communication templates, and customer notification automation for affected enterprise B2B accounts.
Developed reusable server-side components using JavaScript and GlideRecord - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), GlideAjax callbacks for dynamic form behavior, scheduled jobs, and Scripted REST APIs.
Built Flow Designer orchestrations for incident routing based on CI relationships, change automation for network changes, problem investigation workflows, and cross-team coordination using record-triggered flows with subflow libraries, parallel branches, and Decision Tables.
Designed IntegrationHub spokes connecting ServiceNow with Verizon's BSS / OSS ecosystem, billing systems, network management platforms (IBM Netcool, Splunk, Dynatrace), Active Directory, and customer service tools using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication and MID Server connectivity.
Built CMDB / CSDM 4.0+ governance covering CI lifecycle management, IRE reconciliation rules, Health Dashboard scorecards, Service Graph Connectors for hybrid cloud assets, and the data certification campaign discipline enforced quarterly.
Configured Discovery patterns for Verizon's nationwide network infrastructure - MID Server cluster configuration, IP-based and credential-based discovery schedules, horizontal discovery for Windows / Linux servers, and vertical discovery for telecom application services.
Built Service Mapping for customer-facing telecom service applications including wireless billing, customer portal, network operations dashboard, and back-office systems with automated CI relationship discovery and dependency tracking.
Configured Event Management alert correlation rules using regex-based event field mapping and threshold-based alert grouping, consolidating related network alarms, reducing individual alert tickets reaching the NOC, and enabling proactive customer case creation.
Built Service Portal custom widgets using AngularJS for IT support intake, request submission, and knowledge article browsing - configured page layouts, custom themes aligned to Verizon branding, and responsive design with mobile-first patterns.
Configured Service Catalog items for IT services - variables, variable sets, multi-row variable sets for bulk request scenarios, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies for conditional field visibility, and fulfillment workflows.
Established ATF (Automated Test Framework) regression suites with 300+ test cases covering ITSM workflows, ITOM Discovery patterns, CMDB reconciliation logic, and custom integration workflows - enabled a monthly release cycle with zero regression incidents on production.
Managed Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, conflict resolution, and the deployment-promotion gates aligned to Verizon's change-control discipline.
Coordinated with Verizon network operations, IT, and engineering teams - participated in daily Agile / Scrum ceremonies with story sizing, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint demos, and retrospective documentation discipline.
ServiceNow Developer  |  CSM, HRSD & Service Portal	January 2023 – February 2024
WIPRO  (Client: Elevance Health)    ·    Bengaluru, India  ·  Healthcare Insurance
Worked as ServiceNow Developer on Elevance Health's enterprise platform across the Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC releases - delivered CSM, HRSD, and Service Portal implementations for Elevance Health's healthcare insurance operations serving members and providers.
Built CSM Case Management for Elevance Health member services covering case lifecycle, parent / child case relationships, case types (claims inquiry, benefits questions, provider issues, billing disputes), SLA and Entitlements engine, omnichannel intake, and Agent Workspace configuration for contact center productivity.
Configured HRSD Employee Center for Elevance HR operations - HR Case Management with case types (benefits, payroll, leave, onboarding), Lifecycle Events (onboarding, transfer, offboarding) with multi-step task orchestration, HR Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management with HR articles.
Developed reusable server-side components using JavaScript and GlideRecord - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype, GlideAjax-callable), GlideAjax callbacks for dynamic form behavior, scheduled jobs, and Scripted REST APIs for external system integrations.
Built Flow Designer orchestrations for member case lifecycle, HR onboarding workflows, claims case routing, and approval workflows covering record-triggered flows, subflow libraries, parallel branches, Decision Tables for category-based routing, and Wait-for-Condition for SLA-based escalations.
Designed IntegrationHub spokes connecting ServiceNow with Elevance's Workday HCM, Active Directory, monitoring tools, and legacy claims processing systems using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication and MID Server connectivity.
Built Service Portal custom widgets using AngularJS for member self-service, employee request submission, and IT support intake - configured page layouts, themes aligned to Elevance branding, and responsive design with WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance.
Configured Service Catalog items for IT and HR services - variables, variable sets, multi-row variable sets for bulk request scenarios, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies for conditional field visibility, and fulfillment workflows with multi-tier approval matrices.
Developed Virtual Agent topics for member self-service (claims status, benefits lookup, ID card request), IT support (password reset, software request, access request), and HR (benefits inquiry, leave balance, onboarding status) - trained NLU models with healthcare-specific intent recognition.
Built Omnichannel intake configuration for inbound case creation across email (Inbound Email Actions with parsing scripts), web (Customer Service Portal record producers), chat (Virtual Agent with healthcare NLU topics), and Live Agent hand-off patterns.
Configured Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) for skill-based case routing using agent capacity, language skills, healthcare specialization (claims vs benefits vs provider), and geography-based routing ensuring complex member issues reach correctly skilled agents.
Established Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, conflict resolution, and the deployment-promotion gates aligned to Elevance's HIPAA-compliant change-control discipline.
ServiceNow Developer  |  ITSM & Service Catalog	October 2021 – December 2022
ACCENTURE  (Client: Aetna / CVS Health)    ·    Hyderabad, India  ·  Healthcare Insurance
Worked as ServiceNow Developer on Aetna / CVS Health's enterprise platform across the Rome, San Diego, and Tokyo releases - delivered ITSM, Service Catalog, and Service Portal implementations for Aetna's healthcare insurance operations.
Developed Incident Management workflows for Aetna IT operations - configured custom incident categories, assignment rules based on category and CMDB CI relationships, SLA definitions, escalation matrices, and integration with monitoring tools for automated incident creation.
Built Change Management workflows covering Normal / Standard / Emergency change types with CAB approval workflows, risk and impact assessment forms, change schedule conflict detection, and integration with Aetna's healthcare change-control discipline.
Developed Service Catalog for Aetna IT services covering hardware requests, software installation, access provisioning, and IT service requests - configured variables, variable sets, catalog client scripts for dynamic form behavior, catalog UI policies, and fulfillment workflows.
Built Service Portal custom AngularJS widgets for self-service IT support, request submission, and knowledge article browsing - configured page layouts, custom themes aligned to Aetna branding, and responsive design with mobile-first patterns.
Developed JavaScript and Glide API server-side components - authored Business Rules (before / after / async), Script Includes (ClassPrototype), Client Scripts (onLoad / onChange / onSubmit), UI Policies, and ACLs for the regulated healthcare workflow requirements.
Built Flow Designer orchestrations (mature framework in this era) for incident routing, change automation, request fulfillment, and approval workflows replacing legacy Workflow Editor scripts.
Designed IntegrationHub integrations connecting ServiceNow with Aetna's enterprise monitoring tools, Active Directory, healthcare claims systems, and legacy mainframes using REST and SOAP APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication.
Built CMDB governance covering CI lifecycle management, Discovery patterns for Aetna's hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure, IRE reconciliation, and Service Mapping for healthcare application services with dependency tracking.
Configured Knowledge Management with KCS methodology - article lifecycle management, knowledge base structuring, article templates, search optimization, and integration with Virtual Agent for knowledge-driven self-service.
Established Update Set governance across DEV / QA / UAT / PROD environments with naming conventions, dependency tracking, and the deployment-promotion process aligned to Aetna's HIPAA-compliant change-control discipline.
Built Performance Analytics dashboards for IT operations covering incident MTTR, change success rate, SLA compliance, request fulfillment metrics, and service catalog adoption with automated distribution to Aetna IT leadership.
